ronald-acuna-jr.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

rehab_progress.manager_quote: He's probably as strong as he's ever been... When he comes back, we want him to be able to go. We're going to make sure he is ready to go when we do turn him loose.

ronald-acuna-jr.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023 ACL tear. Must progress through Rehab Gate: BP → live pitching → straight-line running → cutting → MiLB rehab → MLB activation.

mookie-betts.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.description: Stiff lower back (day-to-day, since Jul 11) + Right wrist soreness (resolved Jul 2)

injury_history.injury: Right wrist fracture (6-8 weeks, pitching machine accident)

recent_performance.note: On 7-game hitting streak with .355 avg over last 15 games at time of report

mookie-betts.notes: Most tumultuous 2025-2026 stretch in recent memory for a star. All major injuries resolved. Manager Dave Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better. But talking to the training staff, we feel like staying away from him tonight and see how he's feeling tomorrow.' — No IL expected for current back or wrist issues. Conservative treatment. Also: Cody Bellinger on 10-day IL with left calf contusion; Zach McKinstry and Luke Raley handling RHS duties; Chris Taylor manning CF.
mookie-betts.source: MLB.com: Betts out for 3rd consecutive game, NOT expected on IL for current lower back issue

freddie-freeman.name: Freddie Freeman
freddie-freeman.notes: Chronic ankle issues require ongoing load management. 2024 World Series Walk-Off Grand Slam legend. Currently playing regularly with no acute restrictions. Minor right elbow inflammation noted in some reports but not currently listed on IL.
